message.content: Logistic regression is a statistical method used for binary classification. It models the probability that a given input belongs to one of two classes (e.g., success/failure, yes/no) as a function of predictor variables. The model uses the logistic (sigmoid) function to map linear combinations of the predictors to probabilities between 0 and 1, and then typically applies a threshold (often 0.5) to make a class prediction.
